# Alonzo & Phil Gordon

## Shared scenes

> [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats exuberantly with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her suitors back home, her reluctance to grow up, and her impressions of [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). After discovering an old war grave in the cemetery that deeply moves [Anne](../character/anne.md), the trio parts ways. [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) then discuss Phil's lively character, agreeing that despite her frivolity, they genuinely like her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) go for an afternoon walk with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) through the park and along the harbor shore. After watching the sunset from a pavilion, they walk back via [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) points out a charming, quaint house called Patty's Place. [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels an instant connection to the house and has a strong presentiment that she will become better acquainted with it.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

> After finishing term examinations at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday where she is warmly greeted by [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and the twins. That night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps a troubled [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a dilemma about wanting to say a bad word so that he feels ready to say his prayers. During the break, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives letters from her friends, shares news with her family, and visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana.md) to air out the house and listen to the echoes once more.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and successfully arrange to rent the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Afterward, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) to ask if she can live with them at Patty's Place, and they agree subject to consulting [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Patty’s Place

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place and decorate their new home. [Anne](../character/anne.md) reluctantly adopts a stray, disreputable cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), who miraculously survives a chloroforming attempt and earns a permanent spot in the house. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives with her own cats, adding to the household's lively atmosphere.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a pleasant two weeks visiting [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's homestead in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) while being courted by Phil's suitors. She visits her childhood home and meets the current owner, who gives her a packet of old love letters written by her deceased parents. After visiting her parents' graves in the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to read the letters, feeling deeply connected to her mother and father at last.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday
